name: Tidepool
author: CatVinci-Studio
description: Fresh and lively: level-2 headings on a mint pill, small markers before the smaller headings, a dashed rule and tinted quotes, with a calm sea-dark night. After Phycat by sumruler.

zh.description: 清新活泼：二级标题衬在薄荷色胶囊上，较小的标题前有小标记，虚线分隔，引用带底色，夜间是平静的深海色。参考 sumruler 的 Phycat。
